name: Access control
usage: Build one guard with createGuard({ serviceTokens: serviceTokensFromEnv() }) and pass every app route through guard.protectAll(routes); only /health and /ready stay open. Service callers send a bearer token whose SHA-256 digest is in SERVICE_TOKEN_SHA256_<NAME>. Tailnet callers are opt-in: tailnetLogins plus identityProxy: "tailscale-serve" and an explicit trustedProxies IP list (nonLoopbackProxy: true for a non-loopback address); only tailscale serve may ever connect from those addresses, never another reverse proxy. Wrap each route that takes an ID with owned(resolve, handler): resolve reads the ID once (singleParam helps) and returns { id, owner, value } or null; the handler uses only ctx.resource. In an app test call assertAllGuarded(routes) and assertOwned(routes, idRoutes); routeInventory(routes) is the route list for review.
